9 Amazing Gluten Free Apple Recipes

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:05
Instaread

Apple season is here. Make the most of the fall apples with these delicious and amazing gluten free apple recipes.

Read more: 9 Amazing Gluten Free Apple Recipes

In case you’re looking for some fall apple recipes, I’m sharing a few of my favoriyte gluten free apple recipes today. Hope you enjoy.

9 Amazing Gluten Free Apple Recipes

Healthy Apple Bread : Moist + tender apple bread made with crisp apples, applesauce, + apple pie spice. A healthy dessert or snack that’s gluten free + paleo with a vegan option.

Pumpkin Apple Muffins : Who doesn’t love the smell of sweet, cinnamony goodness from the oven on a cool day? These lightly spiced muffins just scream Autumn with all of that pumpkin and apple deliciousness. And that sweet apple topping!  It’s pure perfection.

Apple Bread Bars : These healthy apple bread bars are so yummy and moist with just the right amount of fall flavor. They are loaded with chunks of sweet apples and drizzled with the best maple glaze.

Mini Apple Fritter Waffles : Warm cinnamon and apple deliciousness that tastes amazing right off the waffle iron.  

Cardamom Apple Cake : What I love about apple cake is that it isn’t an overly sweet dessert, and the texture is perfectly soft and moist. It’s a solid cake without being too heavy.

Apple Galette : A galette is a term used in french cooking to describe flat, roundish, crusty cakes.  They look rustic, amazing and fancy, but are so simple to make. 

Cardamom Apple Dutch Baby :  Imagine a hot, fluffy pancake with sweet baked apples and the warm smell of cardamom.  Top it with some real maple syrup. 

Caramel Apple Parfaits : Ready for a warm and comforting fall treat? These parfaits are nut free, gluten free, and dairy free, and full of fall flavor.

Cranberry Apple Chicken Salad Wraps : Crisp apple, tart cranberries, crunchy celery, and bits of toasted pecans.  A great way to use up leftover chicken or even leftover holiday turkey.
